Is array mein ek number gayab hai! Ek se paanch tak ke numbers hain... par ek missing. Interview mein poocha jaaye, toh kaise dhoondhoge?
Zyaadatar log pehle sort karte hain, phir loop. Par sorting matlab n log n! Interviewer ko chahiye O of n.
Coding bhool jao, bachpan ki maths yaad karo! Ek se n tak ka sum: n into n plus one, by two.
Yahan n paanch hai. Toh total sum: paanch into chheh, by two... pandrah!
Ab array ka sum nikalo: teen, ek, paanch, do... gyaarah!
Pandrah minus gyaarah... chaar! Ye raha missing number! Na sorting, na extra space. Time O of n, space O of one.
Interviewer ka twist: n bahut bada ho, toh sum overflow ho sakta hai! Tab XOR use karo. Comment mein batao, XOR wala logic kaise kaam karega?
Aise hi interview tricks ke liye, pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karo!
